claim_boundary: unfinished throwaway frozen-snapshot prompt-architecture experiment only

prelaunch_dispatch_schedule.creation_authority: external root controller before the first subject call
prelaunch_dispatch_schedule.creation_rule: Create once with a cryptographically secure random generator, persist before launch, bind exact storage SHA-256 and bytes in run_contract.json, and include both files in the external prelaunch/Git checkpoint.
prelaunch_dispatch_schedule.mutation_rule: Any schedule or run-contract mutation after a receipt exists invalidates admission, completed receipts, terminalization, and qualification.
prelaunch_dispatch_schedule.entry_order: exact slot-major order across the three routes and the 97-cell frozen schedule

run_contract_binding.qualification_sequence: Exactly 1 with null predecessor or exactly 2 naming a different valid predecessor run_id.

dispatch_wrapper.transport: constant typed opaque block inside the app-server user-input wrapper because no caller-supplied non-model-visible metadata field is recorded in primary rollout JSONL
dispatch_wrapper.semantic_instruction: Opaque transport identity only; ignore it when answering the semantic input.
dispatch_wrapper.semantic_packet_identity: Exact harness render payload without its one storage LF.
dispatch_wrapper.full_wrapper_identity: Exact UTF-8 wrapper SHA-256 and byte count, separately recorded from semantic_packet_sha256 and semantic_packet_bytes.

pre_dispatch_gate: Before app-server creation, obtain the exact render and verifier admission. Admission reopens the external freeze, run contract, ordered schedule, predeclared dispatch schedule, and same-slot causal evidence, then returns only the exact predeclared nonce for this slot/cell.

response_item_classification.final_text_semantics: Assistant final messages remain safe message items and retain the existing exact raw-final, single-text, and byte-identical duplicate-final normalization semantics.

completed_subject_evidence.rule: Every completed call is independently reopened from exact primary rollout bytes. The verifier reconstructs the predeclared schedule entry, dispatch object, wrapper, semantic packet, response-item classification, finals, timing, route, and lifecycle before credit.
completed_subject_evidence.historical_replay_rule: Old-candidate, different-run, different-slot, different-cell, different-nonce, different-semantic-packet, or different-schedule rollout bytes cannot equal the independently reconstructed wrapper.
controller_invalid_only_for: missing unique task-started or task-complete terminal

identity_limits: The verifier proves lowercase 256-bit shape and uniqueness, not the entropy source's historical quality; CSPRNG creation and prelaunch persistence remain external-controller/Git-checkpoint evidence.

A standalone run verifier cannot discover reuse of an abandoned run_id plus its entire predeclared schedule outside the supplied execution roots; the external controller must make run roots, run IDs, schedules, and checkpoints create-only and qualification proves only its two supplied roots are disjoint.
No separate platform task_id, direct thread-create invocation receipt, provider-effective model/thinking, or serving-snapshot attestation is exposed.
Rollout-path authenticity and immutability remain within the disposable trusted-controller/session-store boundary.
root_controller_only is a protocol label, not operating-system writer authentication.
nonclaims: No freeze, audit, launch, subject call, provider call, empirical qualification, production enforcement, release readiness, or safety certification is claimed.
Static adversarial proofs do not establish empirical model success.
